title: Higher derivations on algebras: a Lean 4 formalization
description:
A complete formal verification in Lean 4 with Mathlib of the characterization of higher derivations on (possibly noncommutative) algebras in terms of sequences of derivations, proved in M. Mirzavaziri, Characterization of higher derivations on algebras, Communications in Algebra 38 (2010), no. 3, 981–987.

One direction holds in every characteristic; the converse uses characteristic zero. The formalization contains no sorry.
